intro: Much of Parbhani district sits on the black cotton soil of the Marathwada plateau. It is good farmland, but it swells when it soaks up monsoon rain and shrinks and cracks when it dries in summer. That movement can tilt or loosen a playground post set into it without the right base, so the ground deserves attention before the equipment is chosen.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 410 km from Parbhani. We send it by road within Maharashtra, where we have also installed a playground for Raymond in Thane. Our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment at schools, colleges, societies and public gardens. Send us photos of your ground, ideally one taken in the dry season, along with the size and the age group. We will suggest an installation method and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.html:
Grouting into black soil needs pits that are wide and deep enough to reach firmer ground, filled with concrete that holds the leg steady as the soil moves. Where the top layer is deep, a self-standing base on a levelled concrete pad can be the more stable choice. We decide this once we see your site.

Drainage matters too. Water that collects around the posts makes the soil swell unevenly, so slope the play area slightly and give the water somewhere to go. Check that pieces such as swings and see-saws are still level after each monsoon. You can see one of our Maharashtra projects at Raymond, Thane.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed on black cotton soil in Parbhani?
faq.a: Yes, with the right base. We use deeper grouting or a self-standing installation on a concrete pad, depending on how deep the soft layer is.

faq.q: Why do some playground posts tilt after the monsoon?
faq.a: Black soil swells when wet and shrinks when dry. Posts set in shallow pits can move with it. A proper foundation and good drainage prevent most of this.

faq.q: Do you supply Parbhani and other Marathwada towns?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Parbhani, Nanded, Latur and Jalna, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Patiala sees the full range of north Indian weather in one year: May afternoons in the mid-forties, a humid monsoon and foggy winter mornings when the temperature drops close to freezing. A playground in the royal city has to be comfortable in all of it. That applies at its schools, its colonies and the campuses of its universities and sports institutions.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,270 km from Patiala. We send it to Punjab by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the north installs it. Send us the size of your site, the age group of the children and some photos. We will suggest equipment that stays usable through the seasons and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: A playground for every season in Punjab
sections.html:
Bare metal surfaces get hot in summer and very cold in winter. Roto-moulded plastic slides, decks and seats stay closer to air temperature, so children can use them in both seasons. Galvanised steel frames resist the damp of the monsoon and the winter fog.

Plan shade for summer afternoons, but avoid covering the whole area, because winter sun is welcome. A pergola over seating and slides that face north or east work well. For older children, a climber or a NexLev structure gives more challenge. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Patiala.

faq.q: Can children use plastic slides in Patiala's winter?
faq.a: Yes. Roto-moulded plastic does not get as cold to the touch as bare metal. Wipe off dew or frost on winter mornings before children play.

faq.q: Should the whole play area be shaded?
faq.a: Partial shade usually works best in Punjab. Shade the slides and the seating for summer afternoons and leave some of the area open to the winter sun.

faq.q: Do you install equipment in Patiala and nearby cities?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Patiala, Ludhiana, Ambala and Panchkula, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Patna has a large number of private schools, and several of them run more than one branch across the city and in nearby towns. When a school group sets up new playgrounds, it often wants every campus to look and work the same way, so that parents recognise the school and staff follow one maintenance routine. Planning several sites at once is something we can help with.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,430 km from Patna, and sends it to Bihar by road. Our installation team or a Bihar dealer sets it up. We also supply housing societies, apartment builders and parks along the Ganga. Send us the size of each campus play area, the age groups and photos. We will prepare a layout drawing for each site with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: One playground design across several campuses
sections.html:
Choose a core set of equipment that fits your smallest campus, then add pieces where there is more space. For example, a multi play system and a set of spring riders at every branch, with swings or a merry-go-round added on the larger grounds.

Keep the same colour scheme everywhere. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded shades, so a school can match its uniform or logo. One set of maintenance steps and one after-sales contact then cover every campus. Patna's monsoon brings heavy rain, so check drainage at each site before installation. Our Bihar page covers other towns we supply.

faq.q: Can you supply the same playground to several of our Patna branches?
faq.a: Yes. We can plan a standard set of equipment for all branches and adjust it for each site, with a separate layout drawing for every campus.

faq.q: Who do we contact for after-sales support?
faq.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Patna and nearby towns such as Danapur and Hajipur?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer working in Bihar. The process is the same as for a Patna site.

intro: Phagwara is in the Doaba region of Punjab, where many families have relatives settled in Canada, the UK and elsewhere. Some of our enquiries for Phagwara and nearby villages come from abroad. It may be a family giving a play area to the village school, or a trust funding equipment for a gurdwara ground or a public park.

FunPlay Systems can plan these projects remotely. We make the equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,350 km from Phagwara. It goes to Punjab by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in the north. The town is also home to schools, colleges and housing colonies that buy for themselves. Wherever you are, send us the site size, the age group and photos, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Planning a donated playground from a distance
sections.html:
Ask someone at the site to take photos from each corner, plus a short video walking around the ground. Note where the gate, the building and any trees are. With that, we can draw the layout and share it by email for approval.

Decide early who will look after the equipment once it is installed, such as the school, the gurdwara committee or the panchayat. They should receive the maintenance steps at handover. A Timeless Play or Khel Khud design from Funplay Originals, inspired by Indian games, makes a fitting gift for a village ground.

faq.q: Can we order a playground for a village near Phagwara from abroad?
faq.a: Yes. We can plan it from photos and measurements sent by someone at the site, share the layout and quote by email, and install the equipment through our team or a dealer.

faq.q: Who should look after a donated playground?
faq.a: Whoever manages the site, such as the school or the committee. We hand over maintenance steps at installation, and our after-sales team can be reached for spare parts.

faq.q: Do you supply Jalandhar, Ludhiana and other Doaba towns?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to towns across Punjab, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Phusro is a coal town in the Bermo area of Bokaro district, on the Damodar in Jharkhand. Schools, colliery colonies and housing areas here often have limited staff to look after a playground once it is installed. If nobody is going to repaint, oil or replace parts often, the choice of material matters more than usual.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,440 km from Phusro, and sends it to Jharkhand by road. A dealer in Jharkhand or our own installation team then fixes it on site. We do not have detailed knowledge of every neighbourhood in Phusro, so we plan each site from the photos and measurements you send. Tell us the age group of the children and how the ground is used, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Choosing equipment that needs little upkeep
sections.html:
Roto-moulded plastic has its colour moulded through the material, so it does not need repainting. Galvanised steel is protected by a zinc coating instead of paint alone. Together they need little more than washing to stay in good condition, which helps in a town where coal dust settles on everything.

Fixed pieces such as climbers and slides have no moving parts to service. Keep swings and spring riders to a few, and check their springs and bearings regularly. Those parts carry a one-year warranty, and the frames and roto-moulded parts carry three years.

faq.q: What equipment needs the least maintenance in Phusro?
faq.a: Fixed pieces made of roto-moulded plastic and galvanised steel, such as slides and climbers. Wash them down from time to time to clear coal dust.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Phusro and Bokaro district?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Phusro, Bokaro and Dhanbad, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.

faq.q: Does coal dust damage playground equipment?
faq.a: It mainly affects moving parts and makes surfaces grimy. Regular washing and checks on springs and bearings keep the equipment in good order.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Limited reliable local knowledge of Phusro beyond its location in the Bermo coalfield of Bokaro district; kept the page to practical maintenance advice.

intro: Proddatur, in Kadapa district, is one of the busiest trading towns in Rayalaseema, known for its gold and cloth markets. Its schools, apartment buildings and private layouts are adding play areas, and the first piece most of them ask for is a swing. Swings come in more types than buyers expect, and choosing the right one depends on who will sit in it.

FunPlay Systems manufactures swings and other outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 790 km from Proddatur. We send it by road and our installation team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs it. Rayalaseema is hot and dry for most of the year, so we use galvanised steel frames and suggest shade for the seating. Send us your site size, the age group and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.html:
A toddler swing has an enclosed seat for very young children. A mother child swing lets a parent and a small child swing side by side, which suits society play areas. Double and double-post swings take two children at once and suit busy school grounds.

Every swing needs a long clear zone in front and behind, longer than most people expect. Place swings at the edge of the play area, never across a path. The springs, chains and fittings carry a one-year warranty, and the galvanised frame carries three years. See our full swing range.

faq.q: Which swing suits a society play area in Proddatur?
faq.a: A mother child swing is popular because a parent can swing with a small child. A double swing works well when several older children use the area.

faq.q: How much space does a swing need?
faq.a: A clear safe play area in front of and behind the swing, plus space at the sides. We mark this on the layout drawing for each swing you choose.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Proddatur and Kadapa district?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Proddatur, Kadapa and nearby towns, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: How many children will be on the playground at the same time? That is the first question we ask buyers in Purnia, and it matters more than the size of the ground. A school that sends a whole class out together needs a very different set of equipment from a housing colony where a few children play at a time.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,660 km from Purnia in north-east Bihar. We send it by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it. This part of Bihar is humid and gets a heavy monsoon, so we suggest galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Tell us how many children will use the area at once, their age group and the size of the space, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Planning equipment by the number of children
sections.html:
Count play positions, not pieces. A single slide keeps one child busy at a time, while a multi play system with steps, decks and two slides can occupy many. A four seater merry-go-round takes four children, and a multi see-saw takes several.

For a class at break, aim for enough positions that no child waits long. For a colony, a few well-chosen pieces are enough. Leave the safe play areas clear even when the ground feels crowded. Squeezing pieces together to fit more children is where most accidents start.

faq.q: How much equipment does a school in Purnia need?
faq.a: It depends on how many children play at once. Tell us the class size at break and the age group, and we will suggest enough play positions for that number.

faq.q: Can we place equipment closer together to save space?
faq.a: No. Each piece needs its own safe play area. We would rather suggest a larger multi play system than crowd separate pieces into a small ground.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Purnia, Katihar and Kishanganj?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to north-east Bihar, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Raebareli, in the Lucknow region of Uttar Pradesh, has schools, institutional campuses and residential colonies built around its factories and offices. Buyers here often ask us to explain the warranty clearly before they approve a purchase, especially when the equipment is for a public or institutional site. That is a sensible question, and this page answers it.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our own factory in Vasai, about 1,140 km from Raebareli. We send it to Uttar Pradesh by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it. Central UP has hot summers, a wet monsoon and cold, foggy winters, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Share the size of your site, the ages of the children and a few photos. Our layout drawing will show each piece and its safe play area.

sections.html:
• Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope.
  • One year on springs, bearings and spare parts.

The warranty covers manufacturing defects. It applies when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions, which we share at handover. Damage from misuse, accidents or changes made on site is not a manufacturing defect. If you need to move or modify a piece, talk to us first.

If you notice a problem, contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com with photos. For adult fitness equipment, see our outdoor gym equipment in Raebareli.

faq.q: What does the FunPlay warranty cover?
faq.a: Manufacturing defects, for three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, laminates and rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts.

faq.q: What can void the warranty?
faq.a: Not following our installation and maintenance instructions, misuse, or changes made to the equipment on site. Keep the maintenance steps we give you at handover.

faq.q: Do you supply schools and campuses in Raebareli?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer. Lucknow, Unnao and Kanpur are covered the same way.

intro: In Raichur, between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra, children play outdoors mostly in the early morning and after about five in the evening. For most of the year the midday sun is too fierce. That makes the direction a playground faces almost as important as what is on it, because the low evening sun from the west can make some pieces uncomfortable.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 590 km from Raichur, and sends it to north Karnataka by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it at schools, colonies, power-plant townships and public gardens. Send us your site plan or photos with the north direction marked, the age group and the size. We will plan the orientation and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Facing equipment away from the evening sun
sections.html:
Children sliding down a slide that faces west look straight into the evening sun, and the surface has been heating all afternoon. Where possible, point slide exits north or east. A tunnel slide keeps the sliding surface covered whichever way it faces.

Use buildings and trees on the western side of the site as natural shade, and put the play area in their shadow for the evening hours. Swings can run north to south so children are not swinging into the sun. A pergola from our garden decor range can cover seating where there is no natural shade.

faq.q: Which way should a slide face in Raichur?
faq.a: North or east where possible, so children are not facing the evening sun and the surface stays cooler. A tunnel slide is another option on open ground.

faq.q: Can you plan the layout from our site plan?
faq.a: Yes. Mark the north direction and any buildings or trees, and we will place each piece with its safe play area on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Do you supply Raichur and nearby towns?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Raichur and towns such as Bellary and Gulbarga, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Raiganj is best known outside West Bengal for the Kulik bird sanctuary on its edge, where storks and other water birds nest in large numbers through the monsoon. It is a fitting place for a playground that takes its ideas from birds, animals and plants, and schools here sometimes ask for something that connects children to the nature around them.

FunPlay Systems designs nature-inspired play structures as part of our Funplay Originals range, and makes them, along with our standard equipment, at our factory in Vasai. Raiganj is about 1,710 km away, and the equipment travels to north Bengal by road before our team or a local dealer installs it. Send us your site size, the age group and some photos, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.html:
Chidiyaan is one of our Funplay Originals designs built around birds. The Nature Sparsh and Organic Play ranges take their shapes from plants, animals and natural forms. Children climb, crawl and slide on them like other play equipment, but teachers can also use them as a starting point for lessons about the world outside.

North Bengal is humid with a long monsoon, so we build these structures with weather-proof, corrosion-resistant materials. Give them a well-drained base. Colours can follow the theme, and we have more than 15 roto-moulded shades to choose from.

faq.q: Do you have playground equipment themed on birds and nature?
faq.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals range includes Chidiyaan and the Nature Sparsh and Organic Play collections, all designed by our own team.

faq.q: Will the equipment cope with the monsoon in Raiganj?
faq.a: Our materials are weather-proof and corrosion-resistant. A well-drained base and regular checks after the rains keep the equipment in good condition.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Raiganj and Uttar Dinajpur district?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Raiganj and nearby towns such as Malda and Kishanganj, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Rajahmundry on the Godavari is often called the cultural capital of Andhra Pradesh, and it has a long tradition of schools, colleges and literary institutions. School principals here tend to ask what children will learn on a playground, as well as whether it is safe and durable. Designs that tell a story or use familiar shapes answer that question well.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 970 km away, and brings it to the Godavari districts by road. Installation is done by our own team or by a dealer who works in coastal Andhra. We also supply apartments, function halls with lawns and public parks along the river. Share your site size, the age group and photos, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.html:
Our Funplay Originals are designed by our own team, many inspired by Indian games and nature. The Kagzi range takes its shapes from paper folding, with pieces such as the Paper Boat, which children on the Godavari will recognise at once.

Structures like these give teachers something to talk about and children something to imagine, along with climbing and sliding. The delta's hot, humid summers and heavy monsoon call for weather-proof materials and good drainage. Place the structure where it can be seen from the classrooms, because it often becomes the school's landmark. Children will soon give it a name of their own.

faq.q: Do you make playground designs inspired by Indian themes?
faq.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals range is designed in-house, and many pieces are inspired by Indian games, paper folding and nature.

faq.q: Can a school in Rajahmundry customise a design?
faq.a: We offer design customisation on request and more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades. Tell us what you have in mind and we will suggest what is possible.

faq.q: Do you supply Kakinada, Eluru and other Godavari towns?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to towns across the Godavari districts, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Rajkot, the main city of Saurashtra, has grown outwards with large residential schemes, clubs and private schools on generous plots. On sites like these, a few individual pieces can look lost. Buyers here sometimes want one large play tower that children can see from across the ground and that gives the whole area a centre.

FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures these structures at our factory in Vasai, about 390 km from Rajkot. We send the equipment to Gujarat by road, and our installation team or a dealer installs it. Saurashtra is hot and dry, with strong sun for most of the year, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic, and we plan shade where children wait. Send us your site size, the age group and photos, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: When a large play tower makes sense
sections.html:
Our NexLev series includes our newer, larger play towers and wooden structures. Ranges such as Pinnacle combine climbing, slides and decks at several levels, so older and younger children can use different parts of one structure.

A tower needs a larger safe play area than individual pieces, and it needs access for assembly on site. Check that delivery vehicles can reach the spot. On an open plot, set the tower where its height gives some shade to benches or smaller pieces in the afternoon. If your club or society also wants fitness equipment for adults, it can sit nearby. See our outdoor gym equipment in Rajkot.

faq.q: What large play structures do you offer for a Rajkot club or society?
faq.a: Our NexLev series includes larger play towers and wooden structures. We will suggest one that fits your ground and the age group of the children.

faq.q: How much space does a large play tower need?
faq.a: More than its own footprint, because the safe play area extends around it. Send us your measurements and we will show the full area on a layout drawing.

faq.q: Do you supply Morbi, Jamnagar and other Saurashtra cities?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to cities across Saurashtra, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.
